title: The three wells of value
subtitle: Same wallet, same person. The bread was a reflex, the bag a fantasy, the plumber a rescue.

items.label: Needs
items.note: Keep you alive. Crowded, so buyers compare.

items.label: Wants
items.note: Make life sweet. Fickle, so desire fades.

items.label: Pain
items.note: Makes you act now. Priced against doing nothing.

takeaway: Find the pain, and you've found the value.
